## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? What workflow is improved?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Alternative Approaches
What other solutions did you consider? Why is this the best approach?

## Affected Components
Which OWNEX components would this touch?
- [ ] Core (Event Bus, Scheduler, Memory, Security)
- [ ] Intelligence (MERLIN, Evolution Engine, Recovery)
- [ ] Agents/Departments (Orchestrator, Engineering, Quality, Security, Revenue)
- [ ] Work Cycles (FORGE, PULSE, SECURITY, VAULT, ATLAS, ODYSSEY)
- [ ] Execution (Workflows, Executors, Platform Connectors)
- [ ] Learning (Knowledge Capture, Feedback, Reward Models)
- [ ] Frontend (Vue 3, Mission Control, MERLIN UI)
- [ ] Mobile (Android, Wear OS)
- [ ] Documentation

## Implementation Considerations
- **Breaking changes?** Yes/No — if yes, describe migration path
- **New dependencies?** List any new external dependencies
- **Configuration changes?** New env vars, config options
- **Database migrations?** Schema changes required?
- **API changes?** New endpoints, modified contracts

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Additional Context
Screenshots, mockups, references to similar implementations, etc.
